extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners or applicants seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO (members of the patent bar)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance and standards governing petitions for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, including required supporting materials and what the Office will consider in deciding reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (filing requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: A Petition for Reinstatement must be submitted to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline; the decision references a petition received on a specific date (October 31, 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page indicates the process begins with filing a Petition for Reinstatement (the Petition was received on October 31, 2022). No additional procedural details or format requirements are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: The petitioner must file an affidavit in support of the Petition pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision notes that Mr. Wan filed an affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of his Petition. The page does not reproduce the content of the affidavit or § 11.58, but signals that such an affidavit is a required/supporting document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision based on review of petition, affidavit, and all record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Reinstatement is determined after careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to the petitioner’s eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline considers the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all record information material to eligibility when deciding whether reinstatement is appropriate. This is the stated standard of review on this page; no scoring rubric or further evaluation factors are enumerated here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority of the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline to grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director (Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline) has the authority to determine and grant reinstatement to practice before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision is issued by William R. Covey, Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline, indicating that reinstatement determinations are made by this office/official. The page provides the formal grant ('Petition is hereby GRANTED') but does not detail standards beyond the review described above.
